set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- ADRs cover extension identity, errors, scale lifecycle, target layout, compatibility, batch IR, and provenance.
- Scale, stat, geom, coord, recipe, and backend guides contain compiled examples using only Intaglio's public API.
- Unsafe APIs and totality boundaries are named explicitly.
set.title: [Intaglio 1.0][Documentation] Publish architecture decisions and extension author guides
